messages:
Jordan: Dropped a new flows mock for roles + invite quickpath: https://figma.com/file/zzz
Li: Scanned it. Big thing: audit links from role rows currently navigate away. Suggest open-as-panel to preserve context
Carmen: Panel seems right. +1 to sidecar so you can see filters on the left and audit on the right
Devon: Keyboard/accessibility: side panel must trap focus and then return focus on close. Also add skip-to-main for screen reader users
Priya: On the invite flow, when pasting many emails the UI collapses into a single blobwe should parse into tokens with inline validation
Jordan: Proposed inline tokens: invalid tokens get red outline + tooltip, duplicates get combined with a 1x badge
Li: For SR users, announce "3 invalid emails" with aria-live once parsing completes
Carmen: Tiny copy: current SSO toggle label "SSO required" reads like a policy. Maybe use "Enforce SSO for org" and dropdown "All users / Admins only"
Devon: Agree. Also replace On/Off with explicit text: "Enforced"/"Not enforced" so it's screen-reader friendly
Priya: Contrast issue: audit timestamps at 12px on the side panel are failing AA at smaller widths. Increase weight or move to 13px
Jordan: Note on roles grid: sorting should be click-on-header, not in kebab. Add visual chevrons and aria-sort states
Li: UX nit: when filters are applied and you deep-link to a shared URL, the filter chips disappear until load completes. Show skeleton chips so users know state
Carmen: Also add URL params for sort, filter, query so views are bookmarkable and for audit deep-linking
Devon: Invite CTA copy inconsistency: 'Send invites' vs 'Send invitation(s)'. Recommend 'Send invitations' (plural, clear)
Priya: Accessibility: invite drawer focus order currently moves to the footer buttons before role selection. Need to programmatically focus first interactive control in the drawer
Jordan: Implementation note: use focus trap library + restoreFocus(true) on close
Li: For mobile, expanding role descriptions should be an accordion with icon toggles and clear hit targets (44px min)
Carmen: Add a11y checklist to the figma: keyboard navigation, aria-live for parse summary, focus management, visible focus styles
access-bot: Reminder: UX-review checklist updated: roles-invite-accessibility v1.2
Jordan: I'll update the spec with copy variants and the sidecar behavior. Devon can own focus trapping
Devon: Filed ENG-12458 for focus-trap + restore. Adding repro steps and test plan
Li: I'll prototype URL encoding of filters for deep-linking
Priya: I'll run a screen-reader pass on the invite drawer after the tokens parser is in staging
Jordan: thanks team :thumbsup:
